missing modifier.description: A required modifier is missing from the procedure code.
missing modifier.action: Add the correct modifier based on payer rules and resubmit the claim.

authorization required.description: The claim requires prior authorization which was not included.
authorization required.action: Obtain authorization documentation and attach it before resubmission.

duplicate claim.description: The claim appears to be a duplicate submission.
duplicate claim.action: Verify submission history and ensure the claim has not already been processed.

documentation missing.action: Attach clinical notes and medical necessity documentation.

invalid code.description: The procedure or diagnosis code is invalid.
invalid code.action: Verify CPT/ICD codes and correct them before resubmitting.
